Method.name: SystemParameters
Method.Implementation:
$$$TRACE("Get parameters for: " _ req.Name) set pResponse = "" set tSC = $$$OK
$$$TRACE("Get existing object")
&sql(SELECT top 1 ID INTO :id from IHC_ITF_ITFCOMMON_DataStructure.StoredProcParamsCollection where ProcName = :req.Name) IF SQLCODE=0 { $$$TRACE("Got existing Id: "_id) set pExist= ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DataStructure.StoredProcParamsCollection).%OpenId(id,,.tSC) $$$TRACE("%OpenId: " _ tSC) set pResponse = pExist.%ConstructClone(1) } IF ( (SQLCODE '= 0) || ($$$ISERR(tSC)) ) { $$$TRACE("Call sys.objects") set pResponse= ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DataStructure.StoredProcParamsCollection).%New() SET queryStr= "SELECT Parameter.name AS Name, TYPE_NAME(Parameter.user_type_id) AS Datatype, max_length, is_output " _ " FROM sys.objects AS o INNER JOIN sys.parameters AS Parameter " _ " ON o.object_id = Parameter.object_id WHERE o.object_id = OBJECT_ID('" _ req.Name _ "')"
Set tSC = ..Adapter.ExecuteQuery(.tResult, queryStr) if ($$$ISERR(tSC)) { $$$LOGERROR(tSC) Quit tSC } set pResponse.ProcName = req.Name
//Get the result set numRows = 0 WHILE tResult.Next() { Set tOutParms = tResult.GetData(1)
set colData = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DataStructure.StoredProcParams).%New() set colData.Name = $REPLACE(tResult.GetData(1),"@", "") set colData.Type = tResult.GetData(2) set colData.MaxLength = tResult.GetData(3) set colData.IsOutput = tResult.GetData(4)
set numRows = numRows + 1 $$$TRACE(numRows _ ". SQL Output: " _ tResult.GetData(1) _ ", type: " _ tResult.GetData(2))
Do pResponse.MyProp.Insert(colData) } $$$TRACE("Query output: " _ numRows ) }
Do pResponse.%Save()
$$$TRACE(" Return tSC: " _ tSC _", count #: " _ pResponse.MyProp.Count() _ pResponse.MyProp.GetAt(1).Name) Quit tSC
